再看周围，已然再次进入那白茫茫天地。
“还要得到徒弟认可才能进来么…”
眼神立马锁定在了虚空那众多光团上。
想着，抬头对这片白茫茫天地大喊起来：“刚刚的声音，你是这片世界的管家吗？”
张云也不在意，自顾自继续道：“我知道你能听到我说话，这些光团里，有可以让我变强的吗？最好是那种能先改善我体质的！”
他现在是金丹碎裂的体质，修为处于一个持续倒退期，想变强首先得将体质改善。
难道跟他猜的不一样，那缥缈之声没有灵智？
正想着，面前虚空的光团中，忽然有几道泛起点点特殊光彩。
张云眼前一亮：“你果然能听到！”
看着这几道泛起光彩的光团，忍不住又问。
张云耸肩，挑了挑，选了其中一道看起来最亮的光团伸手摸了上去。
光团一触即散，化为大股能量围绕在他周围。
“获得仙师返还体，是否进行改造？”
身前虚空立马跳出一段光字信息——
‘仙师返还体：拥有此体之人，将会与已认可自身的徒弟形成连接。徒弟每次修炼提升，宿主都会得到百倍修为返还。随着宿主不断升级，此返还倍数也会逐步升级，最高可达至万倍返还！’
“徒弟修炼提升，我获得百倍万倍修为返还？”
有这体质，只要徒弟修炼升级，他岂不是躺平也能变强？
张云直接叫了起来，“改造改造！赶紧改造！！”

叫声一落，那围绕在周围的能量立马涌聚向他。
这一瞬间，张云只感觉自己仿佛置身在一片温暖海洋，身上每个细胞都被温暖包裹。
“检测到宿主体内残留剧毒，现开始清理！”
但还没来及享受几秒，这股温暖就随着眼前一段信息的出现戛然而止。
没来及细想，就感体内一凉，大股能量犹如水流般在他体内进行冲洗。
很快，他只感觉一股逆流上涌，喉咙一苦，张嘴‘哇’的一大口黑血喷吐而出。
黑血落在地上，生起了‘嗤嗤’腐蚀的声响。
在他融合的记忆中，前身应该没有接触过什么剧毒之物。怎么会……
“等等，前身修炼会走火入魔，难道也是因为这个？”
这时，那股温暖的感觉再次包裹上来。

> Chapter 5 Immortal Master Returns the Body (Page 1)
Looking around again, we have entered the vast white world again.
"Do I need to be approved by my apprentice before I can come in..."
His eyes immediately locked onto the numerous light groups in the void.
Thinking about it, he raised his head and shouted to the vast white world: "That voice just now, are you the steward of this world?"
Zhang Yun didn't care and continued: "I know you can hear me. Are there any of these light groups that can make me stronger? It's best to be the one that can improve my physique first!"
He now has a physique with broken golden elixirs, and his cultivation is in a period of continuous regression. If he wants to become stronger, he must first improve his physique.
Could it be that unlike what he had guessed, that ethereal voice had no intelligence?
Just as he was thinking about it, a few rays of special light suddenly appeared in the void of light in front of him.
Zhang Yun's eyes lit up: "You can indeed hear it!"
Looking at these radiant light groups, I couldn't help but ask again.
Zhang Yun shrugged, picked it up, selected one of the brightest-looking light groups, and reached out to touch it.
The light group dispersed at the touch and turned into a large amount of energy surrounding him.
"After receiving the body returned by the immortal master, do you want to undergo transformation?"
A message of light text immediately jumped out from the void in front of him——
‘The Returned Body of the Immortal Master: Those who possess this body will form a connection with the disciples who have recognized themselves. Every time the apprentice improves in practice, the host will receive a hundred times the amount of cultivation in return. As the host continues to upgrade, this return multiple will gradually upgrade, up to a maximum of 10,000 times the return! ’
"As my apprentice improves in practice, I will receive a hundred times a million times more in return?"
With such a physique, as long as the apprentice practices and upgrades, wouldn't he be able to become stronger even while lying flat?
Zhang Yun shouted directly, "Reform and reform! Hurry up and reform!!"
As soon as the cry ended, the energy surrounding him immediately surged towards him.
At this moment, Zhang Yun felt as if he was in a warm ocean, and every cell in his body was wrapped in warmth.
"Remnants of highly toxic poison in the host's body have been detected. Cleanup begins now!"
But before I could enjoy it for a few seconds, the warmth ended abruptly with the appearance of a piece of information in front of me.
Before he had time to think about it, he felt a chill in his body, and a large amount of energy washed through his body like water.
Soon, he felt a countercurrent rising up, his throat felt bitter, and he opened his mouth and spat out a large mouthful of black blood.
Black blood fell to the ground, making a corrosive sound of "chichi".
In his fused memory, his predecessor should not have been exposed to anything poisonous. How could it be...
"Wait a minute, my predecessor's training would go crazy. Is this also because of this?"
At this time, the warm feeling enveloped me again.
